close_reason: Added full doc comment to try_find_cert_ext with fail-closed label and return value semantics.
description: try_find_cert_ext (line 620 of pkix-path/src/lib.rs) is a private function with no doc comment. Its error contract — Ok(None) when the extension is absent, Err when it is present but DER-malformed — is non-obvious and is the exact behavior that distinguishes it from find_cert_ext. A new contributor reading TryFrom<Certificate> will have to read the implementation to understand why the ? propagates. Add a /// doc comment explaining the three-case contract: absent → Ok(None), present+valid → Ok(Some(T)), present+malformed → Err(der::Error).
title: try_find_cert_ext: missing doc comment
